chunks: And Ali عليه السلام used to dislike hajj and 'umrah on camels that feed on impurities.

key_terms.الْجَلَّالَاتِ: animals that feed on impurities or filth
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Did Imam Ali عليه السلام dislike performing hajj and 'umrah on jallalah camels?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Imam Ali عليه السلام disliked performing hajj and 'umrah on camels that habitually fed on impurities. It indicates a juristic discouragement connected to the condition and purity-related status of the riding animal used in acts of worship.
